name: Orca: A Distributed Serving System for Transformer-Based Generative Models
publisher: USENIX OSDI 2022 (Yu, Jeong, Kim, Kim, Chun)
notes: Introduces iteration-level scheduling (continuous batching) so a new request joins the running batch as soon as one sequence finishes, rather than waiting for a whole batch. The scheduling half of the prefill/decode asymmetry problem. The site blocks plain curl (403) but the page was retrieved successfully by the extraction tool.
